name: After recital K
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: Ka. whereas the government attempted to implement a broad programme of reforms to overcome the crises generated by armed violence in rural areas of the country, high levels of exclusion and inequality, and a deterioration in environmental conditions – structural causes that the 2016 Peace Agreement seeks to correct; whereas the government has encountered strong resistance from economic elites, powerful media interests and the traditional parties that control the majority in Congress;
